rule: Simulated update: 10 land tiles of run-mars-001 (seed 20261119) are recomputed with their elevation perturbed by an independent Gaussian error within the stated Copernicus accuracy (sigma 1.216 m, 2 m LE90): a re-release that changes nothing real. Mars is used because its cube reads the local GLO-90 copy (no download); the lunar 30 m cube streams GLO-30. The steps rerun as the planner says (tools/discovery/refresh_plan.py): - features: the 10 tiles at both Mars scales; - assess: the cells of these tiles and of their neighbours (their neighbours' windows are read from the real cube); - zones: only the zones that touch a cell whose candidacy changed (tools/discovery/zones_local.py; David, 23/11:   recompute the neighbours and nothing else). The candidate list of the run is read once as the starting state. Measured: seconds per step and per unit; among the reassessed cells, the share whose coverage state changes and the share whose candidacy at tau 0.5 changes, per target; zones that appear or disappear. Threshold rule: the 1% of ADR-009 stays if the state-change share is under 1% for every target; otherwise it becomes the smallest whole percent above the largest measured share. The zone rule is reported, not changed here.
